g:HTMLPanel.p: The Font Awesome 7 Free icons, with the same options as Bootstrap Icons: sizes, animations, rotation, stacks. Inherit org.gwtbootstrap5.extras.fontawesome.FontAwesome. It changes how every icon name is looked up: Font Awesome first, then Bootstrap Icons, so this page runs as a separate module.

d:Example.heading: Solid, regular and brands
d:Example.description: In UiBinder, `icon` takes a constant name, looked up in `IconTypeFASolid`, then `IconTypeFARegular`, `IconTypeFABrands` and the Bootstrap Icons. Pick a style from Java with `setType`. Font Awesome Free has only a few regular icons.

d:Example.heading: Size, animation, rotation and flip
d:Example.description: `size` is `LARGE` or `TIMES2` to `TIMES5`; `spin` and `pulse` animate; `rotate`, `flip`, `border` and `fixedWidth` are the other options.

d:Example.heading: Stacked icons
d:Example.description: An `IconStack` lays one icon over another: the base one with `stackBase` and the top one with `stackTop`; `inverse` makes it white.

d:Example.heading: In buttons and links
d:Example.description: Buttons, links and nav items take the same options with an `icon` prefix: `iconSpin`, `iconSize`, `iconFixedWidth`...
